reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 38 original verb exercises: checked full German sentences, verb inflection, dative/reflexive/separable constructions, all offered distractors, single accepted answer, bilingual feedback and distinct contexts. Reviewed source CEFR labels and existing production/initial/B2/workplace/general-expansion objectives; no identical verb-specific target mapped. One mistranslated idiom deferred for register/level review. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending. Second editorial pass corrected an awkward speed clause, clarified pushing rather than pulling, and diversified scheiden into distinct separation/divorce senses.
